titlePlain: Formal Writing — Put It in Writing (B2)
subtitle: Writing & Listening · B2 · ~45 min

blocks.title: <ico-recycle></ico-recycle> REPASO EXPRESS · lección anterior
blocks.intro: Antes de empezar, recupera lo de la clase pasada. Une cada expresión con su significado, sin mirar atrás.

pairs.r: una condición que rompe el trato

blocks.title: <ico-book></ico-book> SAME MESSAGE, DIFFERENT SUIT
blocks.intro: Un correo formal dice lo mismo que un chat, pero con otro traje: peticiones indirectas, verbos más formales, conectores con su puntuación y ninguna contracción. Lo importante es saber cuándo ponérselo.

vocab.en: Please do not hesitate to contact me.

blocks.note: Cómo funciona: tarjetas , memory, escucha , reescribir , completar y comparar . CHECK donde lo veas.

parts.html: 1 · TRES REGISTROS, UN MENSAJE — chat, neutral, formal

items.en: Hey, can you send me the contract?
Could you send me the contract, please?
items.sp: Neutral: a casi cualquier persona en el trabajo.

items.en: I would be grateful if you could send me the contract.
items.sp: Formal: a un cliente nuevo, a un equipo legal, a una institución.

parts.html: 2 · CAMBIA EL VERBO — el corto es de chat; el largo, de carta

items.en: We have received your payment.
We would like to request a meeting.
Please inform us of any changes.
The issue has been resolved.

parts.html: 3 · PEDIR SIN ORDENAR — tres marcos para una petición formal

items.en: I would be grateful if you could confirm the date.
items.sp: Le agradecería que confirmara la fecha.

items.en: We would appreciate it if you could reply by Friday.
items.sp: Agradeceríamos su respuesta antes del viernes.

items.en: Could you please return a signed copy?

parts.html: 4 · CONECTORES FORMALES — empiezan la frase y llevan coma

items.en: The price is fixed. However, the dates are flexible.
The contract has been signed. Therefore, work can begin.
Support is included. Furthermore, training will be free.
With regard to the app, it will be part of phase three.

parts.html: 5 · EL ESQUELETO — cinco partes, siempre en este orden

items.en: I am writing with regard to our meeting on Monday.
items.sp: Motivo: por qué escribes, en la primera línea.

items.en: Please find the terms attached.
items.sp: Detalle: los datos o el adjunto.

items.en: I would be grateful if you could return a signed copy.
items.sp: Acción: qué necesitas que haga el lector.

items.en: I look forward to hearing from you.
items.sp: Cierre: quedas a la espera. Después, Sincerely, y tu nombre completo.

parts.html: TRAMPA DEL ESPAÑOL — fórmulas que no se traducen

items.en: Dear Ms. Clark,
items.sp: «Estimados señores» → no uses Dear Sirs, ya suena anticuado. Dear Mr. / Ms. + apellido, o Dear Hiring Team,

items.en: I look forward to hearing from you.
items.sp: «Sin otro particular, quedo a la espera» no se traduce palabra por palabra: este es el cierre.

items.en: I am writing to you about the contract.

parts.body: look forward to + -ing, porque aquí to es preposición: I look forward to hear from you. → I look forward to hearing from you.

blocks.title: THE FORMAL VERSION · toca para girar
blocks.intro: Adelante, la forma de carta. Atrás, la de chat y su significado. Antes de girar, intenta decir la informal.

cards.back: informal: sorry about · pedimos disculpas por
informal: soon · en cuanto le sea posible

blocks.title: <ico-star></ico-star> PUT IT IN WRITING
blocks.intro: El trato tiene que llegar por escrito al equipo legal de David, y la postulación a Team Lead necesita un correo de presentación. El primer borrador de Marcos empieza así: «Hey David, just checking in!!»

blocks.title: MEMORY · chat and letter
blocks.intro: Encuentra cada forma de chat con su versión formal. Toca dos cartas.

pairs.b: I look forward to hearing from you.

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · THE DRAFT
blocks.desc: Sofia lee en voz alta el borrador de Marcos y lo arreglan línea por línea. Fíjate qué cambia en cada frase y por qué.

questions.q: Why does this email need to be formal?
options: David asked for a formal email
David's legal team will read it
I am writing with regard to our agreement.
I am writing to say hello.

questions.q: What does Sofia mean by "Same message, different suit"?
options: The content is the same; only the style changed
Marcos should dress better for meetings
The new email says something different

speaking.prompt: Say Marcos's four formal lines aloud, from memory: the reason for writing, the good news, the request, the close.
speaking.starter: I am writing with regard to… We are pleased to confirm… I would be grateful if you could… I look forward to…

transcript.html: Right, Marcos, let me read your draft. "Hey David, just checking in! We're super happy about the deal. Can you send the signed contract ASAP? Thanks a lot, Marcos."
What's wrong with it? It's friendly.
It's friendly for a chat. But this email goes to David's legal team. Lawyers will read it. Let's go line by line. "Hey David."
For his lawyers, "Dear Mr. Clark." Next: "just checking in."
Hmm. "I am writing with regard to our agreement."
Much better. Now they know why you're writing. And notice: "I am," not "I'm." No contractions.
Okay. And "We're super happy about the deal"?
"We are pleased to confirm the terms of the agreement."
And "Can you send the signed contract ASAP?"
Never "ASAP" to a lawyer. It sounds like an order. Try a request.
"I would be grateful if you could return the signed contract at your earliest convenience."
Not "Thanks a lot." How about: "I look forward to hearing from you. Sincerely," and my full name?

blocks.title: CHAT → LETTER
blocks.intro: Reescribe cada frase de chat en registro formal. Usa el comienzo que ya está escrito y la palabra dorada cuando la haya.

answers: I would be grateful if you could send it.
I would be grateful if you would send it.
items.why: Petición indirecta: I would be grateful if you could + verbo.

answers: Please inform us if anything changes.
Please inform us of any changes.
I look forward to hearing from you.
I look forward to hearing from you soon.

blocks.title: LINK IT FORMALLY
blocks.intro: Elige el conector o la forma que corresponde en un correo formal.

items.q: The price is fixed. ___, the dates are flexible.
The contract has been signed. ___, work can begin on Monday.
Support is included. ___, training will be free for the first month.
___ your question about the app, it will be part of phase three.
I look forward to ___ from you.
I would be grateful if you ___ confirm the date.

blocks.title: SORRY vs WE APOLOGIZE
blocks.intro: Las dos piden disculpas por lo mismo. La diferencia es quién las va a leer.

items.q: ¿Cuál le escribes a un colega cercano?
¿Cuál va en una carta a un equipo legal?
¿Qué tiene A que un texto formal evita?

options: I look forward to hearing from you.
I would be grateful if you could reply by Friday.

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · THE DICTATION
blocks.desc: Priya le dicta a Marcos la carta que confirma el trato. Atrapa los datos: duración, descuento y fechas.

questions.q: How long will the new contract run?
When does the new contract start?
What should Mr. Clark do by March 15?
Why will the mobile app move to phase three?
options: Because phase two will be delivered a month early
Because the discount was too big

speaking.prompt: Read the closing of the letter aloud, slowly and clearly: 'Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me. I look forward to working with you.'
speaking.starter: Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me. I look forward to working with you. Sincerely, (your full name).

transcript.html: Marcos, take this down, please. Dear Mr. Clark, I am writing to confirm the terms agreed at our meeting on March the fourth. The new contract will run for two years, starting on April the first. As agreed, a discount of ten percent will be applied to the monthly fee for the full two years. Furthermore, phase two will be delivered in August, one month earlier than planned. The mobile app will therefore move to phase three. Please find the full terms attached. I would be grateful if you could return a signed copy by March the fifteenth. Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me. I look forward to working with you. Sincerely, and then my full name. Got that? Good. Send it today.

blocks.title: <ico-pen></ico-pen> THE FORMAL EMAIL
blocks.intro: Elige uno: una queja, una propuesta, o tu correo de presentación para un puesto. Escribe el correo completo (6–8 frases) con el esqueleto de cinco partes.
checklist: Saludo con nombre (Dear Mr. / Ms. …,), nunca Dear Sirs
Motivo en la primera línea (I am writing to… / with regard to…)
Detalle con al menos dos conectores (However, / Therefore, / Furthermore,)
Una petición indirecta (I would be grateful if you could…)
Cierre (I look forward to hearing from you.) y ninguna contracción
blocks.example: Dear Mr. / Ms. + apellido, I am writing to + motivo. detalle 1. However, detalle 2. Therefore, consecuencia. I would be grateful if you could acción. I look forward to verbo-ing. Sincerely, tu nombre completo
blocks.hw: Escribe tu correo y después grábate leyéndolo en voz alta, despacio, como si lo dictaras. Envíame texto y audio por WhatsApp.

rubric.d: El correo tiene las cinco partes del esqueleto y el número de frases que pide la consigna.
Registro formal de principio a fin: verbos formales, petición indirecta, conectores con coma y cero contracciones.
Un lector lo entiende sin releer y sabe exactamente qué tiene que hacer.
